name: Aetheris
description: Humanoids with wings.
abilities: Hallowed Aura: Once per long rest when an ally within Close range rolls with Fear, you can change it into a roll with Hope instead.
Celestial Wings: You have wings that allow you to fly. Once per scene while flying, you can spend a Hope instead of marking an Armor Slot.

name: Automaton
description: Advanced mechanical beings of long-gone time.
abilities: Purposeful Design: Decide who made you and for what purpose. At character creation, choose one of your Experiences that best aligns with this purpose and gain a permanent +1 bonus to it.
Efficient: When you take a short rest, you can choose a long rest move instead of a short rest move.

name: Drakona
description: Seed exposure has caused these humans to develop draconic traits.
abilities: Scales: Your scales act as natural protection. When you would take Severe Damage, you can mark a Stress to mark 1 fewer Hit Points.

Elemental Breath: Choose an element for your breath. You can use this breath against a target or group of targets within Very Close range, treating it as an Instinct weapon that deals d8 magic damage using your Proficiency.

name: Dwarf
description: Sturdy folk of mountain and stone.
abilities: Thick Skin: When you take Minor damage, you can mark 2 Stress instead of marking a Hit Point.
Increased Fortitude: Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage.

name: Earthkin
description: Humanoids whose bodies are made of flesh and earth.
abilities: Stone Skin: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Armor Score and damage thresholds.
Immovable: While you're touching the ground you cant be lifted or moved against your will.

name: Elf
description: Long-lived beings attuned to Draft and nature.
abilities: Quick Reactions: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on a reaction roll.
Trance: During a rest, you can drop into a trance to choose an additional downtime move.

name: Emberkin
description: Beings with a natural affinity for fire and heat.
abilities: Fireproof: You are immune to damage from magical or mundane flames.

Ignition: Mark a Stress to wreathe your primary weapon in flame until the end of the scene. While the weapon is ablaze, it gives off a bright light and you gain 1d6 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

name: Faerie
description: Starna beings of glamour and trickery.
abilities: Luck Bender: Once per session, after you or a willing ally within Close range makes an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to reroll the Duality Dice.
Wings: You can fly. While flying, you can mark a Stress after an adversary makes an attack against you to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against that attack.

name: Faun
description: Hoofed folk of the wild places.
abilities: Leap: You can leap anywhere within Close range as though you were using normal movement, allowing you to vault obstacles, jump across gaps or scale barriers with ease.

Kick: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to kick yourself off them, dealing an extra 2d6 damage and knocking back either yourself or the target to Very Close range.

name: Firbolg
description: Gentle giants, hybrid of humans and Starna, connected to the natural world.
abilities: Charge: When you succeed on an Agility Roll to move from Far or Very Far range into Melee range with one or more targets, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d12 physical damage to all targets within Melee range.
Unshakable: When you would mark a Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 6, don't mark it.

name: Fungril
description: Mycelial beings who gained intelligence through Seed exposure.
abilities: Fungril Network: Mark an Instinct Roll (12) to use your mycelial array to speak with others of your Ancestry. On a success, you can communicate across any distance.
Death Connection: While touching a corpse that died recently, you can mark a Stress to extract one memory from the corpse related to a specific moment or sensation of your choice.

name: Galapa
description: Turtle-folk who gained intelligence through Seed exposure.
abilities: Shell: Gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your Proficiency.
Retract: Mark a Stress to retract into your shell. While in your shell, you have resistance to physical damage, you have disadvantage on action rolls, and you can't move.

name: Giant
description: Towering beings of immense strength.
abilities: Endurance: Gain an additional Hit Point slot at character creation.
Reach: Treat any weapon, ability, spell or other feature that has a Melee range as though it has a Very Close range instead.

name: Gnome
description: Small humanoids..
abilities: Nimble Fingers: When you make a Finesse Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die
Flicker Step: Once per scene, you can teleport to another point you can see within Far range.

name: Goblin
description: Small, clever, and fiercely loyal.
abilities: Surefooted: You can ignore disadvantage on Agility Rolls.
Danger Sense: Once per rest, mark a Stress to force an adversary to reroll an attack against you or an ally within Very Close range.

name: Halfling
description: Small folk with big hearts and quick feet.
abilities: Luckbringer: At the start of each session, everyone in your party gains a Hope.
Internal Compass: When you roll a 1 on your Hope Die, you can reroll it.

name: Human
description: Adaptable and ambitious.
abilities: High Stamina: Gain an additional Stress slot at character creation.
Adaptability: When you fail a roll that utilized one of your Experiences, you can mark a Stress to reroll.

name: Infernis
description: Beings touched by burning Draft power.
abilities: Fearless: When you roll with Fear, you can mark 2 Stress to change it into a roll with Hope instead.
Dread Visage: You have advantage on rolls to intimidate hostile creatures.

name: Katari
description: Feline humanoids with keen senses.
abilities: Feline Instincts: When you make an Agility Roll, you can spend 2 Hope to reroll your Hope Die.
Retracting Claws: Make an Agility Roll to scratch a target within Melee range. On a success, they become temporarily Vulnerable.

name: Orc
description: Powerful warriors with fierce traditions.
abilities: Sturdy: When you have 1 Hit Point remaining, attacks against you have disadvantage.
Tusks: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Melee range, you can spend a Hope to gore the target with your tusks, dealing an extra 1d6 damage.

name: Ribbet
description: Amphibious folk who gained intelligence through Seed exposure.
abilities: Amphibious: You can break and move naturally underwater.
Long Tongue: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. Mark a Stress to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals d12 physical damage using your Proficiency.

name: Simiah
description: Primate-like beings who gained intelligence through Seed exposure.
abilities: Natural Climber: You have advantage on Agility Rolls that involve balancing and climbing.
Nimble: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion at character creation.

name: Skykin
description: Beings made of flesh and air
abilities: Gale Force: Mark a Stress to conjure a gust of wind that carries you or a Very Close ally up to Very Far range. Additionally, you can always control the speed at which you fall.
Eye of the Storm: Spend 2 Hope to grant you or an ally within Melee range a +1 bonus to Evasion until you take Severe damage or you use this feature again.

name: Tidekin
description: Beings made of flesh and water
abilities: Amphibious: You can breath and move naturally underwater.
Lifespring: Once per rest when you have access to a small amount of water, you can mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point on yourself or an ally within Very Close range.
